description: "What are the coordinates of [address]" / "geocode [place]" / "lat lng for [location]" / "find [city] on a map" — convert a street address, city, or place name to GPS coordinates (longitude / latitude) using Mapbox's global geocoder. Works on any street, intersection, POI, or administrative area worldwide. Example: geocode_forward({ query: "1600 Pennsylvania Ave, Washington DC" }).
name: geocode_forward
